game.name: Kinectimals (World)(En,Ja,Fr,De,Es,It,Nl,Pt,Zh,Ko,Pl,Ru)
game.desc: Kinectimals is an animal simulation for Xbox 360. Using the Kinect accessory, the player can communicate with five different species of felines by gesture and teach them different tricks. Thirty or so fun activities are also available, as well as tons of accessories to personalise your little protégés.
